<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral system discourse:</strong> Following Donald Trump&#x27;s praise of India’s voter ID system, Congress leader Pawan Khera responded with a sharp critique, urging the U.S. to &quot;take&quot; Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political rhetoric:</strong> Union Minister Kiren Rijiju escalated tensions by accusing the Congress party of &quot;turning into a Maoist party&quot; amid an ongoing row over parliamentary conduct.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
